narrative: A penny almanac open on a knee in the parish church. The date is printed. No pen is in the frame, and no face. The same page. The margin beside the date is empty. Two pews ahead, the back of a furred gown stays turned away.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat the parish hour with his mouth shut and did not mark the day.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached. None of it was kept.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat ahead, turned away, and did not speak.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in The date, and nothing under it
